🇻🇳 **Indian Food in Vietnam! 🇮🇳 | Tasty Banana Leaf Restaurant at an Affordable Price**

Can you find delicious Indian food at an affordable price in Vietnam? 😱 In this episode of **LOST IN ASIA**, I explore an Indian restaurant serving a variety of delicious dishes on banana leaves!

From flavorful curries and rice to traditional Indian meals, discover the taste, food varieties, restaurant atmosphere, and prices of Indian food in Vietnam.

🍛 **What you'll discover in this video:**
✅ Indian banana leaf restaurant in Vietnam
✅ Delicious Indian food and traditional dishes
✅ Affordable food options for Indian travellers
✅ Restaurant ambience and food experience
✅ Is Indian food worth trying in Vietnam?

If you're planning a trip to Vietnam and missing Indian food, this video may help you find a tasty meal while travelling!

📍 Location: Vietnam 🇻🇳
